topicName: CI/CD Pipelines with Fastlane, GitHub Actions, and CodePush
content:
[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Introduction to Mobile CI/CD for Flutter"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) automate the building, testing, and releasing of your Flutter applications. By combining GitHub Actions, Fastlane, and Microsoft CodePush, you can achieve a robust pipeline that delivers both binary updates to app stores and instant JavaScript/assets updates directly to users' devices."},{"order":3,"type":"heading","text":"Prerequisites and Architecture"},{"order":4,"type":"bullet_point","text":"A Flutter project hosted on GitHub."},{"order":5,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Fastlane initialized inside your android and ios directories."},{"order":6,"type":"bullet_point","text":"AppCenter account configured for CodePush deployment."},{"order":7,"type":"heading","text":"Step 1: Configuring Fastlane for Android and iOS"},{"order":8,"type":"paragraph","text":"Fastlane automates code signing and release deployment. Inside your android/fastlane/Fastfile and ios/fastlane/Fastfile, define lanes for building and distributing your app."},{"order":9,"type":"code","text":"platform :android do
  lane :beta do
    gradle(task: 'assembleRelease')
    upload_to_play_store(track: 'beta')
  end
end"},{"order":10,"type":"heading","text":"Step 2: Setting up GitHub Actions Workflow"},{"order":11,"type":"paragraph","text":"Create a workflow file in your repository at .github/workflows/deploy.yml. This file will trigger on pushes to the main branch, set up the Flutter environment, and execute your build steps."},{"order":12,"type":"code","text":"name: Flutter CI/CD
on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.19.0'
      - run: flutter pub get
      - run: flutter test"},{"order":13,"type":"heading","text":"Step 3: Integrating CodePush for Instant Over-The-Air Updates"},{"order":14,"type":"paragraph","text":"CodePush allows you to deploy bug fixes and feature updates directly to users without going through the lengthy app store review process. Install the CodePush plugin and configure it in your main.dart file."},{"order":15,"type":"code","text":"import 'package:code_push/code_push.dart';

void main() async {
  WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();
  runApp(MyApp());
}"},{"order":16,"type":"heading","text":"Step 4: Automating CodePush in GitHub Actions"},{"order":17,"type":"paragraph","text":"Add a step in your GitHub Actions workflow to release updates via CodePush automatically after tests pass."},{"order":18,"type":"code","text":"- name: Install AppCenter CLI
  run: npm install -g appcenter-cli
- name: Deploy to CodePush
  run: appcenter codepush release-flutter -s ./lib/main.dart -a owner/app-name"},{"order":19,"type":"heading","text":"Conclusion"},{"order":20,"type":"paragraph","text":"You have successfully configured a comprehensive CI/CD pipeline for Flutter. GitHub Actions handles the automation trigger, Fastlane manages native store deployments, and CodePush handles rapid, over-the-air client updates."}]
